fieldNotes.needsDate: true when the status schedules a next touch: the screen must ask for a date (and time) and the lead shows in the 'due' filter (A17).
fieldNotes.needsWho: true when the status records which team member did it (who called, who spoke to the lead, who will meet them).
fieldNotes.needsText: extra key, not in the order's shape: true when the screen should ask one short line (here only 'interested in something specific': in what).

statuses.name: Do not contact

statuses.name: Spam
statuses.means: Not a real enquiry (a bot, a test, an unrelated pitch); hidden from the default list, nothing deleted.

sources.says: The content of the customer email had no connection to any services provided by the contact center.
Status: new, contacted, qualified, closed, spam. Spam hides a lead from the default list and deletes nothing.

statuses.name: Lost
statuses.means: The lead was a real prospect but the deal will not happen (chose someone else, stopped replying); not the same as not interested.
